title: TitrateLab peptide COA analysis: vendor-blind aggregates of published lab reports
description: Monthly, vendor-blind aggregates of published peptide certificates of analysis (COAs) by compound, laboratory and month: purity, quantity versus printed label, endotoxin testing and verifiability statistics, with a manifest carrying coverage and missing-data counts and the method behind every figure. No vendor, client, batch or certificate identity is included; every cell holds at least ten records. Per-record evidence with laboratory, client and batch as printed is searchable at titratelab.com/coa.
